notes: Hardy mint-family perennial. Pet product market staple. Nepetalactone repels mosquitoes and cockroaches.
harvestIndicators: Stems cut at first bloom for highest nepetalactone content

careTasks.title: Cutting back the plants during the season also helps to maintain a more compact and neater looking plant.
Cut back plants in the spring just as growth resumes.
The flavor and aroma of catnip is at its peak when the plant is in full bloom.

seasonalTasks.title: Cut back catnip in spring
seasonalTasks.body: Cut the plants back in spring just as growth starts, and divide old plants that look untidy.
